Our Culinary Journey

Punjabi Flavours,
Made with Love

At Punjabi Tadka Indian Kitchen, we bring the authentic flavours of Punjabi cuisine to Niagara Falls. With over 30 years of experience, our culinary journey began in Punjab, where our chef’s passion for traditional Punjabi dishes was born.

We proudly serve as a top Indian restaurant in Niagara Falls, delivering rich, aromatic flavours that keep our community coming back.

We’ve recently moved to our new home at 5677 Victoria Ave — same recipes, same warmth, brand new location.
